board.description: DBPR board code as used by the site's Board select (e.g. 06 Construction Industry Licensing Board, 25 Real Estate Commission). Name searches only. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,3}$.

city.description: City of the main address, as the site spells it (e.g. TAMPA). Name searches only.

county.description: Florida county code as used by the site's County select (e.g. 39 Hillsborough, 47 Leon, 23 Dade; 79 Out of State, 80 Foreign). Name searches only. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,2}$.

cursor.description: Continuation from a previous page: `<page>:<total_records>` as returned in `continuation`. Send the same search fields again. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}:[0-9]{1,9}$.

exact_prefix.description: The site's 'Search Names Beginning with Exactly What You Typed' checkbox (SearchPartName=True). In the recorded samples it did not change the result set.

include_historic.description: SearchHistoric=Y: also return licenses that are no longer current.

last_name.description: Individual's last name (the site matches from the beginning of the name).

license_number.description: Exact license number as printed by the DBPR (e.g. CFC056678, SL3295874, CAM9515). When given, the name fields and filters are ignored except include_historic and per_page.

license_type.description: The site's LicenseType code within the board (e.g. 0604 with board 06). Name searches only; requires board. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

org_name.description: Organization / establishment name or name fragment (e.g. AARDVARK).

per_page.description:
Rows per page (the site's RecordsPerPage choices).

Provider reference: allowed values ["10", "20", "30", "40", "50"]; default 10.

state.description: Two-letter state of the main address (e.g. FL). Name searches only. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

200.description:
Search the Florida DBPR licensee registry (POST /portalsearches/VerifyLicensee/Results). Two modes: by license number (`license_number`, SearchType=SearchByLicenseNumber) or by name (`last_name` / `first_name` / `middle_name` for individuals, `org_name` for businesses and establishments; SearchType=SearchByName). Name searches accept the site's optional filters: `board` (2-3 digit DBPR board code, e.g. 06 Construction Industry, 25 Real Estate), `license_type` (4-digit code within the board), `county` (Florida county code, e.g. 39 Hillsborough, 47 Leon, 23 Dade), `city` and `state`, and `include_historic` for licenses no longer current. Returns the results table as displayed: one row per licensee name (a licensee with a DBA appears once as `Primary` and once as `DBA`, both with the same detail_id), with license type, license number and rank, status and expiry, the address block and the 32-hex detail_id that `get_license_detail`, `get_license_relations` and `get_license_complaints` take. `per_page` rows per page (default 10); the continuation cursor is `<page>:<total_records>` because the site needs the total echoed back to page. A search with no match is a valid empty result (the site's 'There were no records found' message with 'Search Results - 0 Records'), not an error. `data_as_of` is the site's nightly refresh stamp.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addresses` | object[] |  |
| `detail_id` | string | The site's 32-hex licensee id; key for get_license_detail, get_license_relations and get_license_complaints. |
| `detail_url` | string |  |
| `expires` | string | Expiry date YYYY-MM-DD; null when the site prints none. |
| `license_number` | string | As printed; null for rows without one (applications in progress). |
| `license_type` | string | Profession as displayed (e.g. Certified Plumbing Contractor, Real Estate Broker or Sales). |
| `name` | string | As displayed: `LAST, FIRST M` for individuals, the business name for organizations. |
| `name_type` | string | The site's Name Type column: Primary, DBA, ... |
| `primary_status` | string | Part before the comma of status (Current, Null and Void, Involuntary Inactive, ...). |
| `rank` | string | The site's rank line under the license number (e.g. Cert Plumbing, Sales Associate). |
| `secondary_status` | string | Part after the comma of status (Active, Inactive, Probation, ...); null when the site prints none. |
| `status` | string | The site's status text as displayed (e.g. 'Current, Active', 'Null and Void'). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
